question: In a certain code language, KINGDOM is written as LKPHFQN. How will TRIVIAL be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7fd46426f00ba56b91d423458faa673503496b14e50413ec14eae6a6e84c211.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

**First letter is added with +1 and next two letter of word is added with +2 it is repeated.**

KINGDOM is written as LKPHFQN.
